fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

tsh.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
tsh.plain_desc: Brain signal that regulates thyroid speed. High TSH means thyroid is sluggish (hypothyroid).

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Average blood sugar over the last 3 months is in the diabetic range.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Focus on low-glycemic complex carbs, high fiber (>35g/day), and zero sugary beverages.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Kidney filtering rate is slightly reduced or serum waste levels are elevated.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Moderate daily protein to ~0.8g/kg, limit high-sodium foods, and maintain clean hydration.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Liver cells are experiencing mild metabolic stress or inflammation (common in fatty liver).
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eliminate alcohol and high-fructose syrups; add cruciferous greens (broccoli), green tea, and turmeric.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Pituitary gland is working harder to stimulate a sluggish thyroid gland.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eat 1-2 Brazil nuts daily for selenium, ensure adequate zinc/iodine, and cook cruciferous veggies thoroughly.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low blood potassium, which can cause muscle cramps, weakness, or irregular heartbeats.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Incorporate potassium-rich tender coconut water, bottle gourd, spinach, banana and buttermilk.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is significantly elevated, putting excess strain on heart and arteries.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Strict DASH protocol: limit sodium <1800mg/day, boost potassium/magnesium, and reduce stress.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low B12 stores can lead to fatigue, brain fog, and low red blood cell production.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Consume fortified nutritional yeast, dairy/eggs/lean meats, or discuss sublingual B12 with your doctor.

Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

tsh.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
tsh.plain_desc: Brain signal that regulates thyroid speed. High TSH means thyroid is sluggish (hypothyroid).

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

tsh.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
tsh.plain_desc: Brain signal that regulates thyroid speed. High TSH means thyroid is sluggish (hypothyroid).

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Average blood sugar over the last 3 months is in the diabetic range.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Focus on low-glycemic complex carbs, high fiber (>35g/day), and zero sugary beverages.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Kidney filtering rate is slightly reduced or serum waste levels are elevated.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Moderate daily protein to ~0.8g/kg, limit high-sodium foods, and maintain clean hydration.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Liver cells are experiencing mild metabolic stress or inflammation (common in fatty liver).
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eliminate alcohol and high-fructose syrups; add cruciferous greens (broccoli), green tea, and turmeric.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Pituitary gland is working harder to stimulate a sluggish thyroid gland.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eat 1-2 Brazil nuts daily for selenium, ensure adequate zinc/iodine, and cook cruciferous veggies thoroughly.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low blood potassium, which can cause muscle cramps, weakness, or irregular heartbeats.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Incorporate potassium-rich tender coconut water, bottle gourd, spinach, banana and buttermilk.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is significantly elevated, putting excess strain on heart and arteries.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Strict DASH protocol: limit sodium <1800mg/day, boost potassium/magnesium, and reduce stress.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low B12 stores can lead to fatigue, brain fog, and low red blood cell production.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Consume fortified nutritional yeast, dairy/eggs/lean meats, or discuss sublingual B12 with your doctor.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

tsh.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
tsh.plain_desc: Brain signal that regulates thyroid speed. High TSH means thyroid is sluggish (hypothyroid).

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Average blood sugar over the last 3 months is in the diabetic range.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Focus on low-glycemic complex carbs, high fiber (>35g/day), and zero sugary beverages.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Kidney filtering rate is slightly reduced or serum waste levels are elevated.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Moderate daily protein to ~0.8g/kg, limit high-sodium foods, and maintain clean hydration.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Liver cells are experiencing mild metabolic stress or inflammation (common in fatty liver).
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eliminate alcohol and high-fructose syrups; add cruciferous greens (broccoli), green tea, and turmeric.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Pituitary gland is working harder to stimulate a sluggish thyroid gland.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eat 1-2 Brazil nuts daily for selenium, ensure adequate zinc/iodine, and cook cruciferous veggies thoroughly.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low blood potassium, which can cause muscle cramps, weakness, or irregular heartbeats.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Incorporate potassium-rich tender coconut water, bottle gourd, spinach, banana and buttermilk.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is significantly elevated, putting excess strain on heart and arteries.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Strict DASH protocol: limit sodium <1800mg/day, boost potassium/magnesium, and reduce stress.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low B12 stores can lead to fatigue, brain fog, and low red blood cell production.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Consume fortified nutritional yeast, dairy/eggs/lean meats, or discuss sublingual B12 with your doctor.

strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries

Inorganic phosphate food additives (E-numbers in processed snacks)

High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages

Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit

plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.

Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

tsh.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH)
tsh.plain_desc: Brain signal that regulates thyroid speed. High TSH means thyroid is sluggish (hypothyroid).

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Average blood sugar over the last 3 months is in the diabetic range.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Focus on low-glycemic complex carbs, high fiber (>35g/day), and zero sugary beverages.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Kidney filtering rate is slightly reduced or serum waste levels are elevated.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Moderate daily protein to ~0.8g/kg, limit high-sodium foods, and maintain clean hydration.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Liver cells are experiencing mild metabolic stress or inflammation (common in fatty liver).
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eliminate alcohol and high-fructose syrups; add cruciferous greens (broccoli), green tea, and turmeric.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Pituitary gland is working harder to stimulate a sluggish thyroid gland.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Eat 1-2 Brazil nuts daily for selenium, ensure adequate zinc/iodine, and cook cruciferous veggies thoroughly.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low blood potassium, which can cause muscle cramps, weakness, or irregular heartbeats.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Incorporate potassium-rich tender coconut water, bottle gourd, spinach, banana and buttermilk.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is significantly elevated, putting excess strain on heart and arteries.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Strict DASH protocol: limit sodium <1800mg/day, boost potassium/magnesium, and reduce stress.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low B12 stores can lead to fatigue, brain fog, and low red blood cell production.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Consume fortified nutritional yeast, dairy/eggs/lean meats, or discuss sublingual B12 with your doctor.

protocols: Low Glycemic Index (Low-GI) / Insulin Sensitizing Protocol
DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) Protocol
Low-Purine / Alkaline Uric Acid Control Protocol

micronutrient_targets.vit_d_supplementation: High Priority (Suggested 2000-4000 IU/day with doctor confirmation)
micronutrient_targets.vit_b12_supplementation: Suggested 500-1000 mcg sublingual with doctor confirmation

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.
Protein moderation: ~58g/day (0.8g/kg body weight) to ease glomerular workload.
Sodium restriction: < 2000 mg/day.
Serum potassium & phosphorus monitoring (moderate high-potassium/phosphorus additives if prescribed).
Strict restriction of high-purine foods (< 100mg purines/day).
Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
Eliminate all alcohol consumption.
Strict avoidance of industrial fructose.
Include potassium-dense whole foods daily (target 3500-4000 mg/day).
Ensure adequate dietary iodine, selenium, and zinc; cook cruciferous vegetables thoroughly to neutralize goitrogens.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Inorganic phosphate food additives (E-numbers in processed snacks)
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

strongly_recommend: Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar

lifestyle_habits.title: 10-Minute Post-Meal Walk
lifestyle_habits.desc: A gentle 10-minute walk after lunch and dinner significantly blunts post-meal blood sugar and triglyceride spikes.

lifestyle_habits.title: Hydration Rhythm
lifestyle_habits.desc: Drink a large glass of water upon waking and space fluids evenly between meals to assist kidney filtration.

lifestyle_habits.title: Fiber First Principle
lifestyle_habits.desc: Eat your vegetables and salad before your main carbs to create a natural fiber mesh in the stomach that slows sugar absorption.

lifestyle_habits.title: Restful Sleep & Stress Care
lifestyle_habits.desc: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to prevent cortisol spikes that drive insulin resistance and blood pressure.

Cereals, Millets & Pulses: Cereal flakes with milk (1 cup, 220 kcal)

### VERIFIED INDIAN FOOD TABLE - NIN / ICMR 'Dietary Guidelines for Indians'
Use THESE foods and THESE calorie values when building meals. Do not invent kcal.
Items contraindicated for this patient have already been removed from this list.
- **Cereal**: Rice (1 cup) = 170 kcal; Poha (1 cup) = 270 kcal; Idli (2 Nos.) = 150 kcal; Dosa (1 No.) = 125 kcal; Kichidi (1 cup) = 200 kcal; Cereal flakes with milk (1 cup) = 220 kcal

clinical_constraints: Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
strictly_avoid: Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
strongly_recommend: Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
plain_summary: Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.

Report for patient 58 Years Old female. Blood lab specimen reference.
Total Cholesterol 205 mg/dL

clinical_constraints: Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
strictly_avoid: Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
strongly_recommend: Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
plain_summary: Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.

clinical_constraints: Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
strictly_avoid: Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
strongly_recommend: Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
plain_summary: Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is in the mild high range; very responsive to sodium moderation and diet.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

micronutrient_targets.vit_d_supplementation: High Priority (Suggested 2000-4000 IU/day with doctor confirmation)

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.
Strict restriction of high-purine foods (< 100mg purines/day).
Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is in the mild high range; very responsive to sodium moderation and diet.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) Protocol
Low-Purine / Alkaline Uric Acid Control Protocol

micronutrient_targets.vit_d_supplementation: High Priority (Suggested 2000-4000 IU/day with doctor confirmation)

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.
Strict restriction of high-purine foods (< 100mg purines/day).
Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.

strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages

Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is in the mild high range; very responsive to sodium moderation and diet.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.
Strict restriction of high-purine foods (< 100mg purines/day).
Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is in the mild high range; very responsive to sodium moderation and diet.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

micronutrient_targets.vit_d_supplementation: High Priority (Suggested 2000-4000 IU/day with doctor confirmation)

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.
Strict restriction of high-purine foods (< 100mg purines/day).
Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood sugar is slightly elevated above normal. Fully reversible with dietary and lifestyle adjustments.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Replace refined carbs with phulka/chapati, dalia, idli and dals (NIN GI: chapati 52 vs white rice 73), plus daily light physical activity.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Elevated circulating bad fats (LDL/Triglycerides) that can stress cardiovascular vessels over time.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Switch deep-fried items (puri, vada, samosa) for steamed idli and dhokla; cook with mustard or groundnut oil and add flaxseed (alsi).

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: High uric acid in blood; can crystallize in joints (gout) or form kidney stones if unmanaged.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Drink at least 3.0L water daily, avoid beer/spirits and high-purine organ meats, enjoy tart cherries.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Blood pressure is in the mild high range; very responsive to sodium moderation and diet.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Reduce processed/packaged salty foods, use fresh herbs/lemon for seasoning, eat leafy greens.

clinical_flags.plain_meaning: Low circulating Vitamin D, affecting bone density, immune strength, and insulin signaling.
clinical_flags.action_tip: Get 15-20 min gentle morning sunlight, consume fortified foods/egg yolks, and discuss D3 supplementation.

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).

Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar

Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Phulka, Upma, Idli, Dosa, Wheat porridge
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)

clinical_constraints: Max Net Carbs: 150-180g/day; Glycemic Load per meal < 15.
Dietary Fiber target: >= 35g/day with high soluble fiber (beta-glucan, psyllium, legumes).
Saturated Fatty Acids (SFA): < 7% of total daily calories (~12-15g max).
Zero trans-fats; prioritize Monounsaturated (MUFA) and Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fats (PUFA).
Dietary soluble fiber: >= 30g/day to bind intestinal bile acids.
Sodium restriction: < 1500 - 2000 mg/day (equivalent to ~1 level tsp salt).
Potassium-to-Sodium ratio target >= 3:1 (ensure potassium rich foods if kidney function normal).
Magnesium target: >= 400 mg/day.

Eliminate high-fructose corn syrup & alcohol (especially beer).
Hydration target: >= 3.0 Liters clean water daily for renal clearance of urate.
strictly_avoid: White bread, white rice, refined pastries
Deep fried foods, palm oil, hydrogenated fats
Canned soups, packaged noodles, salty snacks, pickles
Monosodium glutamate (MSG) & soy sauce in high amounts
Organ meats (liver, kidneys), red meat, venison
Beer, spirits, high-purine seafood (anchovies, sardines, shellfish)
High fructose corn syrup sweetened beverages
strongly_recommend: Low-GI staples per NIN: Soya beans (GI 16), Barley (GI 28), Chick peas (GI 28), Lentils (GI 32), Apple (raw) (GI 36)
Chapati/phulka (GI 52) in place of white rice (GI 73)
Daily pulses for complementary protein: Plain dhal, Sambar
High-volume, low-calorie vegetables (NIN < 20 kcal/100 g): Amaranth (stem), Ambat chukka, Celery stalk, Spinach stalk, Ash gourd, Bottle gourd
Steamed / griddle-cooked preparations instead of fried: Idli, Dosa
Whole seasonal fruit rather than juice: Apple, Banana, Grapes, Guava, Jackfruit
Season with fresh herbs, lemon and tamarind; NIN caps salt at under 5 g/day
Generous fluids through the day: buttermilk, lemon water, tender coconut water
plain_summary: Swap white rice, maida breads, and sweets for phulka/chapati, dalia, idli, and dals - NIN's own GI table puts chapati at 52 against white rice at 73.
Replace ghee-heavy and deep-fried snacks (puri, vada, samosa, pakora) with steamed idli, dhokla, and roasted chana, and cook with mustard or groundnut oil.
Keep added salt under 1 teaspoon a day (NIN advises less than 5 g), skip pickles and papad, and lean on tender coconut water, spinach, and bottle gourd for potassium.
Stay well-hydrated with at least 3 liters of water daily and steer clear of beer, sodas, and organ meats to flush uric acid.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar after an overnight fast. Key early indicator for diabetes and insulin resistance.

postprandial_glucose.name: Postprandial Glucose
postprandial_glucose.plain_desc: Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal. Shows how efficiently your body clears carbohydrates.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
hba1c.plain_desc: Your 3-month average blood sugar score. Standard metric for diagnosing prediabetes and diabetes.

total_cholesterol.name: Total Cholesterol
total_cholesterol.plain_desc: Total amount of cholesterol circulating in your bloodstream.

ldl_cholesterol.name: LDL Cholesterol (Bad)
ldl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Bad' cholesterol that can form plaque in blood vessels when elevated.

hdl_cholesterol.name: HDL Cholesterol (Good, Male)
hdl_cholesterol.plain_desc: 'Good' protective cholesterol that sweeps excess fats out of your arteries.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.plain_desc: Fat molecules from unused calories. High levels increase heart and liver risk.

creatinine.name: Serum Creatinine
creatinine.plain_desc: Natural waste product filtered by healthy kidneys. Rises if kidney filtration slows down.

egfr.name: eGFR (Kidney Filtration)
egfr.plain_desc: Estimated kidney filtration efficiency. Higher (above 90) means robust kidney cleansing.

bun.name: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN)
bun.plain_desc: Measures waste nitrogen from protein digestion; reflects kidney and hydration status.

uric_acid.name: Uric Acid (Male)
uric_acid.plain_desc: Waste from purine breakdown. High levels can cause painful gout or kidney stones.

alt_sgpt.name: ALT (SGPT)
alt_sgpt.plain_desc: Liver-specific enzyme. Elevated values signal liver inflammation or fatty liver stress.

ast_sgot.name: AST (SGOT)
ast_sgot.plain_desc: Enzyme found in liver and muscle tissue; rises during cellular stress or injury.

bilirubin_total.name: Total Bilirubin
bilirubin_total.plain_desc: Yellow pigment from red blood cell breakdown; reflects liver processing and bile flow.

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.plain_desc: Crucial hormone-vitamin for calcium absorption, bone strength, immunity, and insulin sensitivity.

vitamin_b12.name: Vitamin B12
vitamin_b12.plain_desc: Essential for nerve health, DNA synthesis, and red blood cell formation.

serum_potassium.name: Serum Potassium (K+)
serum_potassium.plain_desc: Vital mineral for heart rhythm, muscle contractions, and fluid balance.

serum_sodium.name: Serum Sodium (Na+)
serum_sodium.plain_desc: Main mineral for fluid volume and blood pressure regulation.
